description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 URI class, providing methods to parse, construct, and manipulate URIs according to the PSR-7 standard, including validation, serialization, and component handling.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing URI parsing, building, and manipulation functionalities following RFC 3986 and PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a URI object, optionally parsing and applying an initial URI string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI, composed from its components.

methods.name: composeComponents
methods.description: Static method to assemble URI string from its components such as scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: isDefaultPort
methods.description: Static method to check if a URI's port is the default for its scheme.

methods.name: isAbsolute
methods.description: Checks if the URI is absolute (has a scheme).

methods.name: isNetworkPathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a network-path reference starting with `//`.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is an absolute-path reference starting with a single `/`.

methods.name: isRelativePathReference
methods.description: Checks if the URI is a relative-path reference that does not start with a `/`.

methods.name: isSameDocumentReference
methods.description: Determines if the URI is a same-document reference with respect to a base URI.

methods.name: fromParts
methods.description: Creates a URI instance from an array of parse_url components.

methods.name: applyParts
methods.description: Internal method to set URI components from an array of parts.

methods.name: filterScheme
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats the scheme component.

methods.name: filterPort
methods.description: Validates and formats the port component.

methods.name: filterQueryAndFragment
methods.description: Sanitizes the query and fragment components.

methods.name: rawurlencodeMatchZero
methods.description: Helper to encode regex matches for URI components.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the URI's components for consistency and correctness.
